scientific_integrity.claim_domain: Binary hypercubes in every integer dimension n>=3; closed radius-one singleton identification; coordinate-permutation-invariant sensor sets
scientific_integrity.computed_scope: Minimum sensor count and number of optimal weight-layer profiles for n=3..20; two independent algorithmic checks of overlapping finite ranges
scientific_integrity.limitations: The 1998 published full-layer construction at n=5 is prior work; no closed formula for all finite n, higher-radius classification or independent audit is asserted. Some later literature was available only in abstract or partial text.
scientific_integrity.proved_scope: Exact three-condition characterization, four-state recurrence for all n, and limiting optimal sensor density one third
scientific_integrity.source_date_note: The day-resolved antecedent date is the 18 April 2008 arXiv deposit. An older 1998 journal article is cited and explicitly compared, but its original first-public-release day was not established from accessible primary text; the arXiv date does not purport to date the origin of the subject.

title: Permutation-symmetric identification in binary hypercubes: a four-state criterion and one-third density
